accessibility.name: Pick it, then sign up to buy it.

texts: Every product here, with what it costs. Pick what you like, then use Sign up to buy it in the shop.
Raw honey from our own hives, jarred in small batches. A little grainy, the way real honey goes.
A slow rise and a dark crust. Baked each morning and sold the same day, so it never sits overnight.
A small tin of salve for dry hands, made with our own calendula. Keep it by the sink.
Contains lanolin. Not for use on broken skin.
A slim notebook with plain pages and a cloth cover, for lists and sketches alike.
Made from the orchard at the back of the farm, sharp and good with cheese or a hot pie.
A tall bottle of cordial, made in June and bottled by hand. Mix it with cold water or fizz.
High in sugar. Best kept in the fridge once opened.
Pick it, then sign up to buy it.
Sign up opens Donkey app, where you add what you want to your basket and pay.
Plain, useful things for the home and the garden, chosen by Donkey and sent out from our workshop.
Donkey, a small shop for everyday things.
